rule: Additive register. Every historical document, board post and cell report is left byte-identical; each row states a claim AS PUBLISHED, the artefact that decides it, and the number that replaces it. A 'none — no replacement exists' row is a real outcome, not a gap: nothing measured replaces the withdrawn figure.
how_to_use: python3 experiments/ptr-engine/tools/withdrawn_index.py --check <file>  # exit 1 = a withdrawn claim is quoted without its correction
python3 experiments/ptr-engine/tools/withdrawn_index.py --self-test  # every decided_by path exists, every superseded_by artefact opens

kinds.wrong_denominator: a proportion over the wrong population (usually 64 turn rows printed as checkpoint accuracy)
kinds.wrong_unit: a count of a different thing than the one named (turn rows read as requests; a column sum read as an endpoint)
kinds.unsound_rule: a rule applied to a number whose evidence does not support it (dedupe by response hash)
kinds.retracted_finding: a published finding withdrawn by later measurement or superseded by an adjudication
kinds.overstated_mechanism: a true reading of one field published as a claim about the whole population

status.withdrawn: no replacement exists or the claim is false as stated
status.superseded: a newer artefact carries the correct number
status.disputed: two records disagree and neither is authoritative

still_citable.never: do not repeat this number in any new document
still_citable.only with the correction attached: the number may appear only beside its correction, instrument and sha
